Author: LeavesInWinter
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Here for the Heart Event Breakdown? Scroll to the bottom. :-)[/b][/size][/center]
[center][b][size=4]Want to bother me? [url=https://leavesinwinter.straw.page]I have a Straw Page![/url] Don't send bug reports there though, I'll get sad :-([/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4]I DO NOT SUPPORT ANY OF MIRREN'S BEHAVIOR (IN THIS OR THE ORIGINAL MOD)[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4]NONE OF THIS IS MEANT TO POKE FUN AT SPECIALAGENTJONSON IN ANY WAY[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Mustache the Florist is a mod of SpecialAgentJonson's mod Mirren the Florist.[/color][/size][/*]
[*]This mod is NSFW and intended only for adults.[/*]
[*]Run any of my work or Jonson's work through AI and I will melt your bones.[/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]Make sure both [CP]Mustache the Florist and MustacheWax are in your mods folder.[/*]
[*]DELETE [CP]Mirren the Florist IF YOU HAVE IT INSTALLED[/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]Mirren has a cool mustache! Did you know that?[/*]
[*]Experience two routes: Pregnant or Bald![/*]
[*]All of Mirren's dialogue has changed. Sometimes a little, sometimes a lot.[/*]
[*]None of the NPC dialogue is different with few exceptions[/*]
[*]Both routes have additional exclusive secret notes[/*]
[*]Streamer Setting to disable copyrighted audio (reboot recommended)[/*]
[*]Permanent Ponytail[/*]
[*]Alternative House Location Only (Except for holidays, of course!)[/*]
[*]Mirren's shop is welded down to the floor and can no longer be moved.[/*]
[*]Useless ice cream toggle[/*]
[*]New farmer animation for Flower Dance (yes it's supposed to look like that)[/*]
[*]Mirren now stands in weird places from time to time as part of his hi-tech schedule (lying)[/*]
[/list][center][size=4][b]Content Warnings[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]Sexual content[/*]
[*]Cartoon violence[/*]
[*]Lots and lots and lots of swearing[/*]
[*]Occasional descriptions of gore[/*]
[*]Unpleasant written sex scene[size=3]s[/size][/*]
[/list][center][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Secret Note Framework[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional)[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][center][b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b][/center]
[size=3]This mod is intended to be played on its own as a stand-alone story. If you plan on cheating for quality of life, the following behaved:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]CJB Cheats Menu[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]CJB Item Spawner[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]MH Event List[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Tractor Mod[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]Using this with any other mods is [b][color=#980000]strongly discouraged[/color][/b].[/size]

[center][b][size=4]General Directions[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]I seriously suggest playing the Pregnant Route first! There's lots of stuff in the Bald Route that works better with the initial context of the Pregnant Route.[/*]
[*]Don't play this with any other mods. It's held together with Sunflower Seed Oil and grease. You will absolutely encounter problems.[/*]
[*]Start with a fresh save file! The story, much like the original mod, is meant to start from day one.[/*]
[*][b][color=#980000]If you care about your save, back it up before 10 Hearts! [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]A lot of the gags are destructive, and the back half of the mod is very heavy in conditional patches. The Pregnant Route is unplayable once you reach the credits.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#980000][b]The Pregnant Route is unplayable once you reach the credits.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]On Bald Route, Mirren has all-new festival outfits! Take him out and show him off![/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]On Bald Route, Mirren has fully new dialogue! Take it slow and spend a year with him before tying the knot![/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Have fun! And remember, you wanted this.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SpecialAgentJonson is absolutely the goat. I couldn't have done this on my own. Most of the code, text, and assets are Jonson's, though any changes are my own. If you're familiar with Mirren the Florist (which you better be!), you'll notice pretty quickly.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Lucian, thank you for perpetuating this nonsense forward and for playtesting the game.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Dream, thank you for your sacrifices made in the name of all things bald and pregnant[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to everyone in the Flower Shop Discord Server. I'd :Happii_Mirren: but, ya'know...[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I have many more thanks to add. Reach the [/color][color=#ffff00][b]mod-exclusive credits scene [/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8]to see them all.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
